rationale: The face appears stylized rather than photographic due to uniform grayscale tones, thick black outlines, and simplified anatomical proportions.
The background elements lack texture or detail, indicating intentional abstraction rather than realistic depiction.
The symmetry and lack of expression suggest deliberate compositional control, though intent cannot be confirmed from visual evidence alone.

limitations: No textual or contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; the interpretation relies on conventional visual associations rather than image-specific evidence.
